Name: Moths for Custom Critters
Author: Squiver
Description:
A simple mod for Custom Critters which adds 5 species of moths which roam the valley after nightfall in the Spring, Summer and Fall!
-------------------------------------------------
To install, you must first install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters[/url]﻿. Then, download Moths for Custom Critters and unzip the contents into the "Critters" folder nested within your Custom Critters folder (do not simply unzip it into your Stardew Valley mods folder or it will not work).
------------------------------------------------
While you're at it, I recommend also adding [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1377]Cranber's Fireflies[/url], which add an extra bit of ambiance and immersion to your night-time farm and which, I believe, pairs very well with this mod!
